title: Neural Architectures

learning_objectives: Explain CNN, RNN, and Gaussian-process model components in plain language and connect it to cyp/models/convnet.py; cyp/models/rnn.py; cyp/models/gp.py.
Trace one input through the neural architectures stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: CNN, RNN, and Gaussian-process model components
practical_outcomes: Trace the neural architectures stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for CNN, RNN, and Gaussian-process model components.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
